## Core Product Categories

### 1. Parasiticides (Key Revenue Driver)

#### Companion Animals
- **Endoparasites** (internal parasites: worms, heartworm)
  - Broad-spectrum dewormers
  - Heartworm prevention
  - Combination products (multi-parasite coverage)

- **Ectoparasites** (external parasites: fleas, ticks, mites)
  - Topical spot-on treatments
  - Oral chewable treatments
  - Long-acting collar options
  - Environmental treatments

#### Key Selling Points
- Broad-spectrum efficacy (covers multiple parasite types in one product)
- Palatability for oral products (high acceptance rates)
- Safety profile across breeds and sizes
- Convenient dosing schedules (monthly, quarterly)
- Cost-effective per-dose compared to premium competitors

### 2. Dermatology
- Medicated shampoos and conditioners
- Ear care products
- Allergy management
- Antimicrobial treatments

### 3. Dental Care
- Enzymatic toothpastes
- Dental chews
- Water additives
- Professional dental products for clinics

### 4. Vaccines
- Core vaccines for dogs and cats
- Kennel cough prevention
- Regional disease vaccines
